summary: Scorpio Tankers filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.45 per common share. Net income for Q2 2026 was $387.5 million ($8.47 basic EPS), with adjusted net income of $243.7 million. The filing also mentions vessel sales gains, debt extinguishment costs, and convertible note issuances. This is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No strategic restructuring, acquisition, or capital return program beyond the regular dividend was disclosed.
